jobs.title: ATU Director
jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within Microsoft Federal, the Health & Science Mission (HSM) organization partners with some of the nation's most important scientific, research, healthcare, and mission-focused agencies to accelerate innovation through cloud computing, AI, security, data, and productivity solutions.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Health & Science Mission to lead a high-performing sales organization focused on driving customer success, business growth, and digital transformation across a portfolio of strategic Federal Civilian customers. This leader will be responsible for developing and executing business strategy, building senior customer relationships, leading a team of sales professionals, and driving adoption of Microsoft's AI and cloud platform across the Federal landscape. The role serves as a key member of the Federal Civilian Area Team Unit (ATU) Leadership Team and partners closely with senior leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Marketing, Partners, and Operations.

Responsibilities

Business Leadership

Lead a portfolio of strategic Federal Civilian accounts to achieve revenue, consumption, market share, and customer success goals.
Develop and execute business plans aligned to organizational priorities and growth objectives.
Drive strategic opportunities and accelerate execution across Azure, AI, Security, Business Applications, Data, and Modern Work solutions.
Own forecasting, pipeline health, territory planning, and business rhythm excellence.

Customer Engagement

Build trusted relationships with customer executives, mission leaders, and technology decision makers.
Establish executive sponsorship strategies that strengthen customer partnerships and accelerate transformation outcomes.
Lead customer planning, executive engagement, and strategic account reviews.
Serve as a senior representative of Microsoft in engagements with customer, industry, and government leaders.

AI and Cloud Transformation

Accelerate customer adoption of Microsoft AI, Copilot, Cloud, Data, and Security solutions.
Partner with technical, customer success, and engineering organizations to deliver measurable customer outcomes.
Drive transformational business initiatives that help customers modernize operations and achieve mission objectives.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a diverse and inclusive team.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer obsession, and growth mindset.
Build leadership pipelines and succession plans while supporting talent development across the organization.
Attract, retain, and develop top talent.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner effectively across Microsoft sales, customer success, specialist, engineering, operations, and partner organizations.
Influence decisions and drive execution in highly matrixed environments.
Lead strategic initiatives and organizational priorities that support long-term business growth.

Operational Excellence

Use data and insights to drive business decisions and improve organizational performance.
Ensure disciplined execution of sales processes, forecasting, opportunity management, and customer planning.
Drive continuous improvement in business management practices and operational rigor.

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR Master's Degree AND 9+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR 13+ years experience in working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR equivalent experience.
8+ years experience making recommendations to and/or collaborating with mid-to-senior level executives.
8+ years experience closing large, complex agreements/deals.

Citizenship & Citizenship Verification

This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local United States government agency customer and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or verified US government Clearance.

Preferred/Additional Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 13+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR Master's Degree AND 11+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR equivalent experience.
1+ year(s) people management experience.
Experience serving Federal Government customers.
Experience leading strategic cloud, AI, security, or digital transformation sales organizations.
Deep understanding of enterprise technology buying cycles and executive engagement.
Experience managing significant revenue accountability and forecasting responsibilities.
Experience developing leaders and building high-performing teams.

Strategic Account Management M5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $133,000 - $222,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $170,300 - $239,800 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Strategy - Temporary Worker
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Temporary Role
ASAP – 12/31/2026
Semi-Monthly, Exempt – W2 on Dentsu Payroll Only
Location: Remote or Hybrid depending on location.
EST Time Zone
Must be US Based

About Dentsu Creative:

Dentsu Creative is a global creative agency network designed to unlock exponential growth for clients. We use Transformative Creativity as a differentiating, driving force to bring our capabilities together to positively impact people, business and society. Established in June 2022, Dentsu Creative is integrated with Dentsu's Media and CXM businesses in over 145 countries and regions, to offer integrated Growth Solutions.

Overview:

TEMPORARY DIRECTOR, INTEGRATED STRATEGY

Reports to:
EVP, Integrated Strategy

YOUR MINDSET

You have developed fluency in disciplines most people keep separate. You don't see creative strategy and media strategy as different languages. You see them as different expressions of the same brilliant strategic thinking and that fluency informs everything you do.

You believe that the best creative ideas scale, that strategic coherence matters, and that you grow by collaborating with people who think differently than you. You contribute with conviction and follow-through. You help build a culture where people understand how their work fits into something bigger and you are here for more than your role. You understand that ideas and how they reach people are equally important—not one secondary to the other.

Role Overview

You will develop and execute a range of integrated strategy projects for a specific brand or strategic focus area within a multi-brand consumer healthcare enterprise, translating strategic direction into inspirational insights and briefs that enable great creative and media execution come together.

This role demands fluency in two disciplines that most separate: Brand Strategy and Connected Strategy. You work from both perspectives simultaneously. You don't just translate between them, you hold them together with clear strategic thinking that helps them operate as one. You understand how strategy needs to live across earned, owned, and paid channels—including social and influencer partnerships.

You turn strategic direction into clear big ideas and briefs grounded in audience insight and media possibility. You work with creative and media teams to help them understand how their work fits together into a coherent whole and inspire both to think bigger and think together. You are the bold strategic voice in the room who helps teams see how their work connects and why that connection matters.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Development — Ideas & Brief

Translate strategic direction into powerful Catalyzing Ideas and briefs grounded in creative insight and contextual possibility
Build the strategic rationale—not just what we're doing, but why it matters and how it moves the business
Develop brand worlds that breathe life into ideas—articulating character, conviction, and edges with specificity
Help creative teams uncover the strategic insight that should drive their work. Help media teams see how that idea scales. Understand how ideas need to live in social and influencer contexts.

Strategic System Operationalization

Identify WHERE ideas reach the right audiences and HOW they show up in context—across paid media, owned channels, social platforms, and influencer partnerships
Research and surface audience signals that inform where and when strategy becomes relevant and urgent
Understand signal stacking—how multiple signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
Help teams understand how their work feeds the whole and why that connection matters

Cross-Disciplinary Alignment & Leadership

Work with creative, media, social, and influencer partners to ensure strategy translates consistently across all touchpoints
Help creative teams understand media strategy and what's possible at scale. Help media teams understand creative strategy and what ideas demand. Bridge social and influencer thinking into the broader strategic conversation.
Bridge creative and media conversations so both disciplines understand they're working from the same foundation
Think in both languages simultaneously—you are fluent in creative strategy AND media strategy, weaving them together

Stakeholder Communication & Relationship Building

Brief brand partners and internal stakeholders on strategy with clarity and confidence
Be a reliable strategic voice partners turn to when asking "how should this idea work?" or "how does this fit what we're doing?"
Engage with senior team to gather input and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities

Team Contribution & Development

Support team leadership by modeling integrated thinking
Mentor junior strategists, helping them understand systems thinking, not just tactical execution
Ask good questions that help teams think beyond their discipline
Contribute to creating psychological safety where people challenge siloed thinking

Measurement & Learning

Help monitor how strategy translates in market and gather feedback for refinement
Support measurement that tracks whether the system is working, using data as feedback not just reporting
Contribute insights on how ideas are propagating and whether signals are clustering as predicted

What Success Looks Like

Your strategic briefs are clear, actionable, and inspiring. You are a student of great work and hungry to do your best work
Creative and media partners use your strategy as a real tool, not just a document. They understand how the two disciplines work together
Teams understand the coherence in what they're building—how each piece connects to the whole. They think in systems, not just tactics
You've demonstrated you can develop strategy and help bring it to life in integrated ways
Junior strategists learn systems thinking by working with you. You are an inspiring mentor to junior talent
Measurement shows ideas propagating and signals clustering as predicted
Relationships deepen because you bring perspective that helps partners operate more strategically

Key Qualifications

Experience:

6-10 years strategy experience with demonstrated fluency in BOTH creative strategy AND media strategy
Proven ability to develop and communicate breakthrough strategic thinking, not just execute briefs
Track record working on consumer or B2C brands in complex strategic environments
Experience working across creative and media functions
Comfort engaging with senior stakeholders in strategic conversations
Experience with social media platforms and/or influencer partnerships a plus

Intellectual Foundation:

Understanding of how ideas propagate and land in culture—not just single-moment performance
Ability to hold multiple perspectives, audiences, and signals in mind simultaneously
Comfort moving between strategic thinking and tactical execution, between 30,000 feet and the work itself
Understanding of signal stacking—how audience signals cluster to create moments of greatest impact
Genuine curiosity about how creative and media thinking complement and inform each other
Evidence that you think about systems, not just campaigns
Evidence that you learn from people and disciplines different from your own

Communication & Collaboration:

Strong communicator who can brief stakeholders with clarity
Ability to contribute ideas within a broader strategic framework
Genuine interest in how creative and media thinking complement each other
Collaborative spirit; you get smarter working with others
Ability to mentor and develop other strategists

Additional Information:

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.

The annual salary range for this position is $154,473-$206,093. 
Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.  Temporary employees are eligible for paid holidays in accordance with dentsu policy, as well as safe and sick time. This position is not eligible for any other benefits or other compensation.  

To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:

The organization operates in the Connected Operations technology sector, focusing on industries integral to the global economy such as agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing. It addresses the challenge of optimizing physical operations by providing a platform that harnesses Internet of Things (IoT) data to generate actionable insights aimed at improving safety, efficiency, and sustainability. This platform supports large-scale digital transformation efforts for fleet and operational management.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Senior Product Manager
will lead a key product area focused on converting operational data into tools that help large fleets reduce fuel costs, enhance efficiency, and manage energy transitions. This role is responsible for defining product vision and strategy, collaborating across multiple teams to deliver impactful products that optimize cost and energy use. The position plays a critical role in advancing the organization’s mission to improve fleet performance and operational cost control.

3. Responsibilities:

Own product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a specific product area such as fuel cost optimization, fleet efficiency, or energy management.
Transform telematics and operational data into products that help customers reduce expenses and improve fleet performance.
Conduct in-depth discovery with stakeholders like fleet owners and operations leaders.
Design prototypes and MVPs to validate ideas with users before development.
Deliver end-to-end product experiences in collaboration with design, engineering, and data science.
Define success metrics and build business cases to support new initiatives.
Promote and embody the organization’s cultural principles during global scaling.

4. Requirements:

Minimum 5 years of product management experience with a record of launching scalable products.
Demonstrated ability to design, prototype, and manage cross-functional product launches.
Proficiency in data analysis, KPI definition, and collaboration with data science teams.
Strong customer research skills and ability to translate insights into product strategy.
Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience with products involving partnerships, integrations, or external data.
Domain knowledge in fuel/energy, fleet management, fintech, logistics, or electric vehicles.
Experience developing AI or ML powered features.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position varies based on factors including location, skills, and experience.
This role is eligible for an initial RSU grant without a vesting cliff and ongoing refresh grants.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Advertiser Experience
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart Ads is one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important parts of the Instacart business. Our Ads organization brings together product, engineering, data science, design, sales, and strategy to build a world-class advertising ecosystem — one that serves brands, retailers, and agencies looking to reach millions of shoppers at the point of purchase.

The Advertiser & Partner Experience (APEX) team sits at the heart of this ecosystem. We own the flows and tools that advertisers use to create, manage, optimize, and understand the value they derive from campaigns and promotions across Instacart Ads. Our scope spans Ads Manager and its APIs, advertiser-facing reporting and insights, retailer advertising products, and Carrot Ads — a growing suite of tools that enables retailers to monetize their own e-commerce sites using Instacart's ad tech, brand partnerships, and expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a critical portion of the Advertiser Experience — specifically, the tools and platform capabilities that help advertisers understand the value they're getting from Instacart Ads, trust those results, and act on them. This PM will also own the core platform infrastructure that underpins all aspects of campaign creation, management, and reporting, including API, product library, user management, change history, billing, and notifications.

This role is an opportunity to own a high-impact, highly visible product surface that directly shapes how advertisers engage with and derive value from one of the industry's most exciting retail media platforms. Over time, as you demonstrate mastery of your scope, you'll have the opportunity to take on increasing strategic ownership and step into a senior PM lead role for the Advertiser Experience team as a whole.

About The Job

Own the problem space of advertiser value measurement — defining how advertisers understand, trust, and act on the results they're seeing from Instacart Ads campaigns, and building the reporting and insights experiences that make that possible.
Own and evolve core platform capabilities that support all stages of the advertiser journey, including API infrastructure, product library, user management, change history, billing, and notifications — ensuring these foundations are reliable, scalable, and built to support a sophisticated advertiser base.
Serve as a primary product point of contact in external conversations with advertisers and agency partners — sharing roadmap direction, gathering strategic feedback, and helping to nurture relationships that inform product decisions and drive trust in the platform.
Work cross-functionally across a 100+-person Ads R&D team — collaborating with engineers, data scientists, designers, and researchers — as well as with sales, strategy, and commercial enablement teams to drive alignment and deliver impact across a complex, fast-moving organization.
Grow into a senior PM lead for the Advertiser Experience team over time, including providing strategic guidance and serving as a thought partner to a more junior PM on the team, as you demonstrate command of your scope and expand your ownership footprint.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of independently owning complex, cross-functional product areas.
Experience building or owning B2B platform products, including enterprise UX flows and underlying platform infrastructure.
Strong technical acumen — comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams on system design, APIs, and platform architecture.
Experience managing external partner or customer relationships as part of a product role, not just internal stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and business context for both engineering teams and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in ad tech, retail media, or marketplace advertising, particularly on the demand or advertiser side — for example, owning advertiser-facing campaign management or reporting flows.
Familiarity with programmatic advertising concepts, including auction mechanics, ad serving, attribution, billing and revenue share, and reporting infrastructure.
Prior experience at a company where the platform you owned enabled third-party businesses to operate — such as a white-label ad platform, a marketplace API, or an embedded commerce product.
Experience driving strategic expansion into new business verticals or partner segments.
Demonstrated ability to ship in ambiguous, high-stakes environments where product scope, technical constraints, and business requirements are evolving simultaneously.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.
